description: Get exact record additions, corrections, and withdrawals between saved published version keys and the current public versions. Corrections identify verified changes to public fields where historical detail exists. Withdrawals link to a persistent public notice for the comparison. Follow nextPage with the same knownVersions before saving the new keys. An unknown checkpoint or unavailable source means the exact comparison is incomplete.

changePage.description: Copy a source's nextPage exactly and keep the original knownVersions.

knownVersions.description: Version keys from an earlier response. Omit on the first check.

title: Check reviewed LrrK updates
